function.name: FormatCompareFn
function.description: This function compares two strings in a case-insensitive manner.

parameters.name: l
parameters.description: Pointer to the first string to be compared

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: Pointer to the second string to be compared

function.return_type: int, returns a negative, zero, or positive value based on the comparison of the two strings

function.name: VARIANT_GetNamedFormat
function.description: This function searches for a named format in an array of named formats using binary search. If found, it returns the format, otherwise it returns NULL.

parameters.name: lpszFormat
parameters.description: This is the name of the format to be searched for in the array of named formats.

function.return_type: BYTE pointer. It represents the named format if found, otherwise NULL.

function.name: VarTokenizeFormatString
function.description: This function tokenizes a format string and stores the tokens in a byte array. It is used for parsing and formatting date, time, number and string formats.

parameters.name: lpszFormat
parameters.description: Pointer to the format string to be tokenized.

parameters.name: rgbTok
parameters.description: Pointer to the byte array where the tokens will be stored.

parameters.name: cbTok
parameters.description: Size of the byte array.

parameters.name: nFirstDay
parameters.description: Specifies the first day of the week.

parameters.name: nFirstWeek
parameters.description: Specifies the first week of the year.

parameters.name: lcid
parameters.description: Locale identifier that specifies the locale.

parameters.name: pcbActual
parameters.description: Pointer to an integer that receives the actual size of the tokenized format string.

function.return_type: HRESULT - Returns S_OK if successful, or an error value otherwise.

function.name: VARIANT_FormatNumber
function.description: This function formats a number according to the specified format, flags, and locale. It handles different number types, including integers, fractions, and exponents, and applies appropriate formatting rules such as adding thousand separators or handling negative numbers.

parameters.name: pVarIn
parameters.description: Pointer to the input VARIANT that contains the number to be formatted.

parameters.name: lpszFormat
parameters.description: Pointer to the format string that specifies how the number should be formatted.

parameters.name: rgbTok
parameters.description: Pointer to the token array used for parsing the format string.

parameters.name: dwFlags
parameters.description: Flags that control the formatting process.

parameters.name: pbstrOut
parameters.description: Pointer to the output BSTR where the formatted number string will be stored.

parameters.name: lcid
parameters.description: Locale identifier that specifies the locale to use for formatting.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: VARIANT_FormatDate
function.description: This function formats a date in a VARIANT structure according to the specified format, flags, and locale.

parameters.name: pVarIn
parameters.description: Pointer to the VARIANT structure that contains the date to format.

parameters.name: lpszFormat
parameters.description: Pointer to the format string that specifies the formatting of the date.

parameters.name: rgbTok
parameters.description: Pointer to the tokenized format string.

parameters.name: dwFlags
parameters.description: Flags that control the function's behavior.

parameters.name: pbstrOut
parameters.description: Pointer to the BSTR that receives the formatted date string.

parameters.name: lcid
parameters.description: Locale identifier that specifies the locale.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, the return value is S_OK. If the function fails, the return value is an error code.

function.name: VARIANT_FormatString
function.description: This function formats a string based on the provided parameters and returns the result.

parameters.name: pVarIn
parameters.description: Pointer to the variant to be formatted

parameters.name: lpszFormat
parameters.description: Pointer to the format string

parameters.name: rgbTok
parameters.description: Pointer to the token array

parameters.name: dwFlags
parameters.description: Flags to control the formatting

parameters.name: pbstrOut
parameters.description: Pointer to the output BSTR

parameters.name: lcid
parameters.description: Locale identifier to be used for formatting

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function execution

function.name: VarFormatFromTokens
function.description: This function formats a variant according to the specified format, tokens, flags, and locale. The result is stored in an output string.

parameters.name: pVarIn
parameters.description: Pointer to the variant to format.

parameters.name: lpszFormat
parameters.description: Pointer to the format string.

parameters.name: rgbTok
parameters.description: Pointer to the token array.

parameters.name: dwFlags
parameters.description: Flags to control the format.

parameters.name: pbstrOut
parameters.description: Pointer to the output string where the result is stored.

parameters.name: lcid
parameters.description: Locale identifier to use for the format.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds, and an error code if it fails.

function.name: VarFormat
function.description: This function formats a variant and stores the result in a string.

parameters.name: pVarIn
parameters.description: Pointer to the variant to format.

parameters.name: lpszFormat
parameters.description: Pointer to the format string.

parameters.name: nFirstDay
parameters.description: Specifies the first day of the week.

parameters.name: nFirstWeek
parameters.description: Specifies the first week of the year.

parameters.name: dwFlags
parameters.description: Flags to control the function behavior.

parameters.name: pbstrOut
parameters.description: Pointer to the BSTR where the result is stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function.

function.name: VarFormatDateTime
function.description: This function formats a date and time variant into a string, based on the given format and flags.

parameters.name: pVarIn
parameters.description: Pointer to the variant to be formatted.

parameters.name: nFormat
parameters.description: The format to be used for the date and time.

parameters.name: dwFlags
parameters.description: Flags to be used in formatting.

parameters.name: pbstrOut
parameters.description: Pointer to the output string where the formatted date and time will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns E_INVALIDARG if the input parameters are invalid.

function.name: VarFormatNumber
function.description: This function formats a variant number according to the specified format settings.

parameters.name: pVarIn
parameters.description: Pointer to the variant to format.

parameters.name: nDigits
parameters.description: Number of digits to use in the format.

parameters.name: nLeading
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use leading zeros in the format.

parameters.name: nParens
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use parentheses for negative numbers in the format.

parameters.name: nGrouping
parameters.description: Specifies the grouping of digits in the format.

parameters.name: dwFlags
parameters.description: Flags to control the format.

parameters.name: pbstrOut
parameters.description: Pointer to the output BSTR where the formatted string will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns E_INVALIDARG if the input parameters are invalid, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, DISP_E_TYPEMISMATCH if the type conversion fails, and S_OK if the function succeeds.

function.name: VarFormatPercent
function.description: This function formats a variant into a percentage string. It first checks the validity of the input parameters, then copies the input variant, changes its type to double, multiplies it by 100, and formats it into a number. If all these operations succeed, it appends a percentage sign to the end of the string, frees the original string, and allocates a new string to hold the result.

parameters.name: pVarIn
parameters.description: Pointer to the variant to be formatted

parameters.name: nDigits
parameters.description: Number of digits after the decimal point

parameters.name: nLeading
parameters.description: Number of leading zeros

parameters.name: nParens
parameters.description: Whether to use parentheses for negative numbers

parameters.name: nGrouping
parameters.description: Grouping of digits

parameters.name: dwFlags
parameters.description: Flags controlling the function's behavior

parameters.name: pbstrOut
parameters.description: Pointer to the output string

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It can be a success code, an error code, or a warning code

function.name: VarFormatCurrency
function.description: This function formats a variant into a currency string. It uses the system locale settings to format the currency.

parameters.name: pVarIn
parameters.description: Pointer to the variant to format.

parameters.name: nDigits
parameters.description: Number of digits after the decimal point.

parameters.name: nLeading
parameters.description: Determines if leading zeros should be used.

parameters.name: nParens
parameters.description: Determines if negative numbers are enclosed in parentheses.

parameters.name: nGrouping
parameters.description: Determines the size of number groups.

parameters.name: dwFlags
parameters.description: Flags to control the function's behavior.

parameters.name: pbstrOut
parameters.description: Pointer to the BSTR that receives the formatted string.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. Returns standard COM error codes.

function.name: VarMonthName
function.description: This function retrieves the name of a month based on the input parameters. It supports both abbreviated and full month names, and handles localization.

parameters.name: iMonth
parameters.description: This parameter represents the month number (1-12).

parameters.name: fAbbrev
parameters.description: This parameter determines whether the function returns the abbreviated (if non-zero) or full (if zero) month name.

parameters.name: dwFlags
parameters.description: This parameter is currently not supported and is ignored.

parameters.name: pbstrOut
parameters.description: This is an output parameter. The function will store the resulting month name in the BSTR pointed to by this parameter.

function.return_type: HRESULT. It represents the status of the operation. It will return S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the month number is out of range, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, or the error code of the failed Windows API function.

function.name: VarWeekdayName
function.description: This function retrieves the localized weekday name for a given weekday and locale settings. It validates the input parameters, determines the first day of the week, and retrieves the localized weekday name.

parameters.name: iWeekday
parameters.description: The number of the weekday (1-7).

parameters.name: fAbbrev
parameters.description: Flag to determine if the abbreviated weekday name should be returned.

parameters.name: iFirstDay
parameters.description: The first day of the week (0-7). If 0, the default first day of the week for the locale is used.

parameters.name: dwFlags
parameters.description: Flags to modify the function's behavior. Currently not supported.

parameters.name: pbstrOut
parameters.description: Pointer to a BSTR to receive the weekday name.

function.return_type: HRESULT. It represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK on success, E_INVALIDARG if the arguments are invalid, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, or the error code from GetLastError if the GetLocaleInfoW function fails.
